SHARP.name: Sharp
SHARP.lore: A blood-red edge carved into one face.

SWARM.name: Swarm
SWARM.lore: Moss spores that multiply your squad.

WILD.name: Wild
WILD.lore: A prism face that answers to every element.

GLASS.name: Glass
GLASS.effect: ×2 Count when scored; 1 in 4 it shatters.
GLASS.lore: A crystal face: huge power, fragile.

IRON.name: Iron
IRON.effect: ×1.5 Count while held (not picked) when a squad scores.
IRON.lore: A steel face that helps from your hand, not the squad.

TOMB.name: Tomb
TOMB.effect: +50 Power, no element, no points; always scores.
TOMB.lore: A gravestone face: no element, no points, big Power.

GILDED.name: Gilded
GILDED.effect: +$3 in the spoils if held after the last summon.
GILDED.lore: A gold face that pays if it stays in your hand at the end.

LUCKY.name: Lucky
LUCKY.lore: A clover face that sometimes goes off.
